text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Unidentified white man's body among those exhumed in eastern city of Owerri which led to riots over ritual murders.
- Government minister alleges that two exiled opposition groups are funding pirate radio.

- Commonwealth divided over Nigeria and its meeting in New York on Saturday to decide whether or not to impose sanctions on the nation for alleged human rights violations is expected to be deadlocked.
